name: packaging-operator-real-context
usernameSql: SELECT u.username FROM sys_user u WHERE u.status=1 AND u.username<>'admin' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND COALESCE(ur.is_visible,true) AND r.role_code='ROLE_ADMIN') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role_menu_permission p ON p.role_id=ur.role_id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.menu_id=p.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND COALESCE(ur.is_visible,true) AND m.menu_code='MENU_PKG_OP' AND p.perm_codes::text LIKE '%V%') ORDER BY u.user_id LIMIT 1
